user.title: Add template climate
user.description: Create a climate entity driven by templates. Every field except the name is optional; attributes without a template run in optimistic (assumed state) mode.

data_description.device_id: Link this entity to a device so it appears under that device instead of as a standalone helper.
data_description.availability: Template resolving to true/false to mark the entity (un)available.
data_description.icon: Template returning an icon name, such as mdi:radiator.
data_description.picture: Template returning a URL or path to a picture for the entity.
data_description.current_temperature_template: Template returning the current temperature, e.g. '{{' states('sensor.room_temp') '}}'.
data_description.min_temp_template: Template returning the lowest temperature that can be selected. Overrides the fixed minimum temperature.
data_description.max_temp_template: Template returning the highest temperature that can be selected. Overrides the fixed maximum temperature.
data_description.min_humidity_template: Template returning the lowest humidity that can be selected.
data_description.max_humidity_template: Template returning the highest humidity that can be selected.
data_description.target_temperature_high_template: Template returning the upper target temperature when a temperature range is used.
data_description.target_temperature_low_template: Template returning the lower target temperature when a temperature range is used.
data_description.hvac_mode_template: Template returning the current HVAC mode. Leave empty for optimistic mode.
data_description.hvac_action_template: Template returning the current HVAC action (heating, cooling, idle, ...).
data_description.fan_mode_template: Template returning the current fan mode.
data_description.preset_mode_template: Template returning the current preset mode.
data_description.swing_mode_template: Template returning the current swing mode.
data_description.set_hvac_mode: Actions run when the HVAC mode is changed. The chosen mode is available as '{{' hvac_mode '}}'.
data_description.set_temperature: Actions run when the target temperature is changed. Available variables: '{{' temperature '}}', '{{' target_temp_high '}}', '{{' target_temp_low '}}', '{{' hvac_mode '}}'.
data_description.set_humidity: Actions run when the target humidity is changed. Available as '{{' humidity '}}'.
data_description.set_fan_mode: Actions run when the fan mode is changed. Available as '{{' fan_mode '}}'.
data_description.set_preset_mode: Actions run when the preset mode is changed. Available as '{{' preset_mode '}}'.
data_description.set_swing_mode: Actions run when the swing mode is changed. Available as '{{' swing_mode '}}'.
data_description.modes: HVAC modes offered by this entity. Type to add a custom value.
data_description.fan_modes: Fan modes offered by this entity. Type to add a custom value.
data_description.preset_modes: Preset modes offered by this entity. Type to add a custom value.
data_description.swing_modes: Swing modes offered by this entity. Type to add a custom value.
data_description.min_temp: Lowest temperature that can be selected. Used when no minimum temperature template is set.
data_description.max_temp: Highest temperature that can be selected. Used when no maximum temperature template is set.
data_description.temp_step: Step size used when adjusting the target temperature.
data_description.precision: Precision the temperature is displayed with (0.1, 0.5 or 1.0).

error.invalid_template: One of the templates is invalid.
error.invalid_action: One of the actions is invalid.
